SF-1.rationale: tests/conftest.py now calls _install_usage_log_guard() at import time and assigns the guarded callable to _usage.append_jsonl before test modules are collected, while pytest_unconfigure restores _ORIGINAL_APPEND_JSONL. tests/unit/test_usage_log_guard.py now captures append_jsonl with a module-level from-import and proves that an unredirected call raises pytest.fail.Exception, names REAL in the failure, and leaves the real directory snapshot unchanged.

summary: SF-1 is resolved. The guard is now installed during conftest import, before test-module collection, and the added purpose-written test verifies that a module-level from-import cannot bypass it.
